steps.note: The soured buttermilk is boiled to firm up its curd.
The whey is taken off the curd.
The drained curd is mixed with salt.
The curd is formed into small balls, strips or chunks.
The shaped curd is left in the sun and wind for weeks, the traditional way.

sources.text: The steps of boiling the buttermilk, straining, salting, shaping and sun-drying are from the Wikipedia article on qurt; the pressing and cutting of Mongolian aaruul from the travel site, which is low authority. Temperatures and times are not given.
